Preheat oven to 325°F. Place muffins on a baking sheet, cover loosely with foil, and warm for 8-10 minutes. Remove foil for the last 2 minutes to refresh the crumble topping.

Dish: GF PB Dark Chocolate Chip Cookies
Instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F. Place cookies on a baking sheet and warm for 5-7 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before enjoying — they are best served warm.

Dish: Creamy Chicken Stew & Homemade Buttermilk Biscuits
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place stew in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 20-25 minutes until bubbling. Warm biscuits on a baking sheet for the last 8-10 minutes, uncovered.

Dish: Herb Marinated Pork Tenderloin & Smashed Baby Potatoes
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place pork and potatoes on a baking sheet or in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 15-20 minutes. Remove foil for the last 5 minutes to re-crisp the potatoes.

Preheat oven to 350°F. Place salmon on a baking sheet, cover with foil, and bake for 10-12 minutes until warmed through. Serve over sushi rice at room temperature or gently warmed. Top with cucumber mango salad cold and drizzle with gochujang aioli.

Dish: Hot Honey Halloumi Pearl Couscous Bowl
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place halloumi and couscous in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 10-12 minutes. Remove foil for the last 3 minutes to re-crisp the halloumi. Top with arugula and pickled red onion cold, and drizzle with lemon olive oil dressing.

Preheat oven to 350°F. Place meatballs and orzo in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 15-18 minutes until heated through. Stir gently before serving.

Preheat oven to 275°F. Place steak on a baking sheet, cover with foil, and warm for 15-20 minutes until just heated through — low and slow preserves the texture. Warm roasted garlic whipped cauliflower in a covered oven-safe dish at the same time. Serve asparagus warm or at room temperature.

Dish: Vegan Lentil Meatballs with Indian Coconut Curry Sauce
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place meatballs in an oven-safe dish, spoon curry sauce over the top, cover with foil, and bake for 15-18 minutes until heated through. Warm basmati rice in a separate covered dish. Serve with roasted mushrooms warm or at room temperature.
